violations.text: Inspector observed heat sanitizing dishwasher with a rinse temperature of less than 160F. Establishment was not using dishwasher at the time of inspection. Dishwasher can be used to wash/rinse, but must use 3 bay sink to sanitize. New Violation. Correct By: 07/01/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener, mixer) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. PIC states that equipment is part of shared commissary space. PIC cleans and sanitizes all equipment prior to use. New Violation. Correct By: 02/02/2024
